segments.title: 9/11 Broadcast: Charlie Kirk Assassination, Trump Response, Anti-BDS Bill
segments.notes: Case Blackwell anchors breaking coverage of Charlie Kirk shooting at Utah Valley University, FBI suspect photos, Trump's video statement blaming radical left, and House passage of Boebert bill banning federal contracts for companies boycotting Israel.

segments.title: How To Have Cyber Sex, Be Safe, and Bond With Stray Cats
segments.notes: Jeb Nogget presents three instructional videos: cyber sex acronyms (TDTM, GYPO, NIFOC, ICQ), a fire safety cartoon with Carmen and Billy, and three steps to befriend stray cats (get low, bring treats, let them sniff). Jeb's Dad interjects from the wooden board.

segments.title: Clementine Verne on the Grass Conspiracy
segments.notes: Conspiracy correspondent Clementine Verne (Guy Redacted) insists the greatest hidden truth is that humans should eat grass like cows, citing ancient cave paintings of monkeys with lawnmowers and grass bread made with hammers. Case cuts the segment short after grass dominates the runtime.

segments.title: Grocery Store vs Supermarket Debate
segments.notes: Crum argues 'grocery store' is the honest term; Munch defends 'supermarket' as aspirational. Debate devolves into personal attacks: Crum's Miller Light sponsorship, Munch's hellish Slurpees (30% glass dust), Crum's penile ring-shape from the gorilla punch, and the delayed Wall rescue mission.

segments.title: Chat News: Beast Boy Firing, Charlie Sheen Ice Cube, Paraglider vs Balloon, Inflatable Plane Airbags, Panty Scrunchies, $15K Sex Dolls, Taylor Swift Engagement
segments.notes: Rick hosts viewer-submitted stories: Greg Cypes claims Warner Bros fired him over Parkinson's; Charlie Sheen shoved ice cube up butt to wake up; paraglider survives mylar balloon entanglement; engineers propose external airbags for planes; Japanese brand sells $119 panty ribbon bows; sex doll pricing game reveals $15K model; Kendall owes Big J Dub a sub on Taylor Swift engagement bet.

segments.title: Park Interviews: ICQ Proposition, Gerald Gardena, Fake Regi, Hamtaro Crack Seeker, Levitating Makeup Face, Sea Turtle Egg Manes, Pirate Ghost, Bidet Sponsorship, Pee Joke
segments.notes: Trip Bradstein fields park visitors: a fan asking to hold it while he pees; Gerald Gardena seeking bush asylum and offering oral sex; a Nintendo Direct-obsessed fake Regi; Hamtaro cultist requesting $5 for crack; man with 2D floating infection makeup; sea turtle egg mane salesman; Jack Sparrow ghost reminiscing about Zune and Pirates movies; bidet sponsorship confusion; and a punchline about holding a nice body against pee.

segments.title: Sensual Ballad: South Florida Football Players' Embrace Not Gay
segments.notes: DJ Newsic auto-tunes a romantic ode to punter Chase Lyanna and holder Nico Grammatica's post-game lip touch, celebrating 'football sexuals' and interviewing a gay football who loves to nut and be hiked. Ends with raid shoutouts to Bruce Green and Riri.

episode_summary: Case Blackwell anchors a 9/11 broadcast covering the Charlie Kirk assassination, Trump's controversial video response, and a House bill targeting BDS boycotts of Israel. Jeb Nogget delivers a chaotic How To segment on cyber sex acronyms and stray cat bonding. Conspiracy correspondent Clementine Verne insists grass-eating is the supreme hidden truth. Munch and Crum debate grocery store versus supermarket terminology while Crum's infernal penile condition and the delayed Wall rescue mission loom. Rick hosts chat-submitted news including Beast Boy's firing, Charlie Sheen's ice cube anecdote, inflatable plane airbags, and $15,000 sex dolls. Trip Bradstein interviews park denizens including a crack-smoking Hamtaro convert and a sea turtle egg salesman. DJ Newsic closes with a sensual auto-tuned ballad about college football players' intimate embrace.
